_doc: Single client-labour MIA expedition. MaxExplorationRate 2800 is the default, not a normalization: external arrival sets the per-category budgets 1680/2800/3920 (the old 2400/4000/5600 cut by 30% once the stay got a daily schedule - followSchedule) through the optional progressBudget=INTEGER argument to CharaMIAWithFeatures before begin/validation; DurationHour 168 remains the backstop. Base features are nsfw + erav_client_labour. Common atmosphere belongs to the erav_client_labour feature module. The seven client_<category> modules are independent content examples, not engine-required categories; the engine composes all modules whose requireKeywords are present. Current external arrival selects one client feature; no category is rolled or mutated here. The begin handler uses first-match briefing dispatch and a neutral fallback when none match. Category modules supply their own encounter IDs and three atmosphere placeholders each; encounters may also be shared between modules (escort/ - currently listed by client_celeb). Category-folder majors weight 1/cooldown 24h and minors weight 10/result-only; shared escort encounters set their own weights, time windows and cooldowns, and may use auto (silent) result events (see SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md). Existing external release/homecoming IDs and empty rescue settings retained. This nsfw directory remains skipped in safe mode; external generic fallback is not changed. Old seven category expedition definitions are replaced, not aliases; external arrival/save migration is owned outside this subtree.

list._comment_schedule: Shared daily schedule for every client (not the Kiryu office's hours): the party rests during mealHours, its sleep window (the members' sleep need, ending at the first ActiveHours hour) and outside ActiveHours - the captive leaves the job and sandboxes the party room (camp bed/meal + campFurniture). campFurniture and provisions are added when the stay starts and removed again when it ends; provisions stay lootable by a rescue meanwhile. One meal item is enough (a non-player inventory hands out copies).

list._comment: shared escort encounters (escort/expEvent_escort_daily.json) - other client modules with public escort duty may list the same IDs

Engine begin hook; not banked. Feature membership is injected before validation. Dispatch options contain comparison + jump ONLY because executor lists do not short-circuit. No random selection, actor loans, AP, or ResolveEvent callback in the briefings themselves - except begin_celeb, which continues (nextEventID) into the celeb intro scene, and that scene loans clients and runs AP. These are content-specific briefing examples, not an engine category requirement. First matching briefing wins if several client features are supplied; encounter modules still compose independently. No match uses the neutral fallback. Every briefing and fallback path terminates.

events.label: begin_celeb
events._comment: Celeb arrival narration, then continues into the interactive intro scene event_erav_celeb_intro (celeb/expEvent_celeb_intro.json) in this same instance: self = player (always visible, unlike an NPC-self StartEvent on the captive), Targets[party] = the captive, feature keywords kept. ErAV_NTR_Punishment's arrival_celeb stays a silent terminator.

list._comment: Provision of expedition_erav_ntr_mia_clients only (Expedition.provisions) - keep it out of every other inventory, the stay's end removes this item ID from the MIA party. No ItemComponent_Degradable (the single copy must not spoil), no 'industrial' tag, do_not_sell - same as consumable_jp_hospital_meal.

zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_politician:
车沿着山路开进箱根，在温泉旅馆的别栋前停下。
议员的鞋已经在玄关摆好了。带路的女将低着头，把$party.name$领向檐廊深处——
从今晚起，她是这栋别栋的「随行秘书」，直到商谈结束。
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_producer:
事务所楼上的出租会议室里，补光灯已经架好了。
自称社长的男人翻着$party.name$的资料，抬头笑了笑，指指房间中央的空地。
「最终面试」就从这里开始。
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_sm_master:
车开进郊外毫不起眼的宅邸。地下室的灯亮着，四壁挂着的皮具如同解剖图，按部位分类。
穿开衫的老人推了推老花镜，指指墙上白板里那张排满的周间时间表。
$party.name$的这周，已经被买下了。
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_sports:
酒店的套房里聚满了高大的外国球员。领队翻着合同，朝$party.name$抬了抬下巴。
翻译转述了半句就停住了。从今晚起，她是这支球队的「随队女性」——训练、比赛、酒店，全程跟队。
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_celeb:
深夜的车在酒店后门停下。开车的人摇下车窗，把房卡递出来。
「顶层的贵客点名要导游。上去吧，别让人等。」
手机随即震了两次，事务所的短信把话说得很直：这几天，她是那队外国明星的专属导游；客人要什么，她就得给什么；能抵掉的利息，按客人开心与否结算。
$party.name$低头看完短信，指节把房卡攥得发白。电梯门在她面前打开了。
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_household:
城西的大宅门前，灰布上衣的女管家递给她条围裙和手写的作息表。
「在这栋房子里，你不用名字。大家叫你『小妹』。」
$party.name$低头看了看作息表——清晨五点半起床，休日：无。
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_gang:
旧旅馆的顶楼整层被包下了。走廊里烟味呛人，房间里七八个小弟围着矮桌打牌。
带队的若头把$party.name$的契约啪地拍在桌上：
「哥几个，这周的犒劳品到了。」
zh-cn.event_erav_clients_begin_fallback:
车停在一栋陌生的建筑前。
$party.name$被桐生组的人领了进去，身后的门无声地合上了。
从今天起，她要在这里「抵账」。
